_doc: Named, capped exceptions to a budget. Each needs a reason and a way out. Never raise a budget instead of adding an entry here, and remove the entry when the cause is fixed.

RESP-TINY-TEXT.reason: KPI cards (Handlebars charts) carry inline font-size:clamp(8px,1.4vh,10px/11px) in the chart definition stored in the database, not in the repository.
RESP-TINY-TEXT.way_out: Edit the chart templates (backups and script: scripts/moh/ui-tests/tools/fix-handlebars-kpi.mjs) with an owner/admin account, then delete this entry.

color-contrast.reason: Same KPI cards: color:#6b7280 on #f4f5f7 is 4.43:1 (needs 4.5:1); stored in chart definitions in the database.
color-contrast.way_out: Same as above (#6b7280 -> #4b5563 gives 6.9:1), then delete this entry.
